Weather and slopes

What it's like up there, before you leave home

Sinaia has two floors of weather: it can rain in town while it snows at Cota 2000. Before you board the train, check the webcam and message us on WhatsApp: we're 3 minutes from the station from 08:00 and we'll tell you how the slopes are, what's open and whether the day is worth it.

Where to look in the morning

The Sinaia Gondola Facebook page posts every morning, around 8 - 8:30, the conditions at Cota 2000: which runs are open, how the snow is, what the weather is like up top. The slope webcams show a live picture. And from 08:00, we reply on WhatsApp.

The ski season in Sinaia

The slopes usually open in December, depending on snow cover, and close sometime in April. There's no skiing in town: the slopes are up above it and you go up by gondola. Snow in town tells you nothing about snow up top.

Frequently asked questions

If the weather is bad or the gondola isn't running, can I cancel or move my booking?
Yes, at no cost. If you've paid for equipment and the gondola didn't run at all that day, we refund you. If you went up and skied, and the gondola closed towards the end of the day, the rental stays paid.
When does the ski season in Sinaia start?
Usually in December, when the snow cover allows. The season ends sometime in April. We announce on the site and on WhatsApp when we're open.
Can you ski in Sinaia when there's no snow in town?
Yes, often. The slopes are up at Cota 1400 and Cota 2000, where it snows even when it rains in town. Check the webcam or the gondola's page, not your window.
Can I go up with the old cable car from the centre?
You can, but we don't recommend it: it departs every half hour and carries 35 people per trip. When it's busy, you wait a long time.
